title: 手不痠嗎
summary: "We've done tons of user testing on this, and it turns out it doesn't work. Touch surfaces don't want to be vertical. It gives great demo, but after a short period of time you start to fatigue, and after an extended period of time, your arm wants to fall off. It doesn't work, it's ergonomically terrible."
content:
"We've done tons of user testing on this, and it turns out it doesn't work. Touch surfaces don't want to be vertical. It gives great demo, but after a short period of time you start to fatigue, and after an extended period of time, your arm wants to fall off. It doesn't work, it's ergonomically terrible."

（我們做了超多使用者測試，結果發現行不通。觸控表面不想要是垂直的。展示的時候看起來很酷，但用一下子手就開始痠，用久了，手臂簡直要廢掉。真的不行，人體工學上爛透了。）

──Steve Jobs，2010 年，當被問到為什麼不在 MacBook 上做觸控螢幕

"You can converge a toaster and a refrigerator, but those aren't going to be pleasing to the user."

（你當然可以把烤麵包機跟冰箱合在一起，但使用者不會開心的。）

──Tim Cook，2012 年，對於微軟「平板＋筆電二合一」產品的評論

"We really feel that the ergonomics of using a Mac are that your hands are rested on a surface, and that lifting your arm up to poke a screen is a pretty fatiguing thing to do."

（我們真的覺得，用 Mac 的正確姿勢就是讓手好好放在平面上。要舉起手臂去戳螢幕，可是有夠累人的。）

──Craig Federighi，2018 年

然後⋯⋯

Apple 宣布，即將推出觸控螢幕的 MacBook Pro。

我很好奇他們是怎麼修好「手會痠」這個 bug 的。

（"Touch transforms pro workflows."──是的，有了觸控 MacBook 之後，專業音樂人終於可以擺脫沈重的 MIDI 鍵盤，改在一片搖搖晃晃的玻璃上用兩隻手指彈鋼琴了唷！看起來果然是超專業的！）

其實我現在用的的 ThinkPad X280、T480s 和 Microsoft Surface Go 2 筆電也都有觸控螢幕，不過我每年大概只有一兩次會想到：「欸對，它有觸控耶！」象徵性地滑兩下之後，繼續回到觸控板和鍵盤。
